# Meridian Field Notes

Source: https://studio.example.invalid/meridian
Brand: Meridian Studio

Draw inspiration from a calm editorial field-guide site for independent architecture walks. Keep the design abstract: a tactile map-led first view, compact route cards, and a quiet saved-walks panel.

Palette:

- paper #F7F2EA
- ink #18201B
- accent green #2E7D5B
- line #C9D2C2

Typography: a poised editorial serif for headings, a clear humanist sans for reading, and monospace only for short route labels.

The site should feel grounded, observant, precise, and useful. Use restrained reveal motion, visible focus states, and mobile layouts that keep the map controls usable without covering route details.
